text: Kaawee ko nanirta wa maɓɓe nden ñalnde kaawee ko yi'irta wa maɓɓe, ɓe nanii fewndo nanɗe nafataa ɓe, ɓe yi'ii fewndo giiɗe nafataa ɓe, kono tooñooɓe ɓen ka ngurndan aduna hiɓe e nder majjere ɓanngunde gaayi Laawol Focciingol ngol, ɓe alaa heblanaade Laakara on haa o ara e maɓɓe e juhayee hara kamɓe hiɓe e hoore tooñe maɓɓe ɗen.
